methods.aggregation: mean signed score drop over covering patches
methods.display: positive map values normalised independently to their maximum; signed patch deltas retained
methods.target_policy: predicted class, plus actual class when different; fixed within an explanation
methods.occlusion_edge_policy: include final full patch position to cover every pixel
methods.caveat: local model diagnostics, not causal evidence; patch fill can create out-of-distribution inputs

provenance.input_split: validation only; first saved validation source index per class
